review.note: Reviewed every current build/runtime/dev/Node registry candidate, including versions outside declared bounds; all latest candidates satisfy the manifest and accept Python 3.14. h2hdb 0.36.0 is required for epoch 3/schema 6; real read-only SQLite bootstrap and 16 targeted consumer/dependency tests passed on its published wheel, with the older 0.35 lane removed. Requests 2.34.2 remains latest and its Mapping header typing is compatible (https://github.com/psf/requests/releases/tag/v2.34.2). Reviewed build 1.6.0 constraints-hash fix and deprecation rollback (https://github.com/pypa/build/releases/tag/1.6.0), Ruff 0.16.5/0.16.6 bug fixes without enabling preview rules (https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.16.6), packaging 26.3 requirement/marker fixes (https://github.com/pypa/packaging/blob/main/CHANGELOG.rst), and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.2 dependency updates and Node >=22 requirement (https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Repository-local Python 3.14.1 uses these latest tools; fast gate passed without compatibility shims or rule relaxation. Full merge gate and installed-wheel requirement/origin/SQLite checks are separate release evidence.
